scope: Built game in headless Chromium software WebGL; scripted rendering fixtures, not a physical device benchmark or portal approval
results: fifteen shipping PBR maps match their source manifest
all shipping character GLBs contain UVs, weighted skeletons, textures and eight animation clips
two authored props match their manifest and contain UV-mapped GLB geometry
five classes render actual textured skinned meshes and animate bones while walking
real attack and skill inputs select distinct skeletal animation clips
six chapters load textured environment meshes and render screenshots
touch viewport loads the upgraded scene and keeps graphics inside the canvas
blocked model and surface requests retain a visible playable fallback
unresponsive asset transfers time out without holding game startup open
